announcements.title: Withdrawn v0.23.0: install v0.23.1 manually
announcements.summary: v0.23.0 was published by mistake. It contains unverified PR changes and may use the wrong update channel. Please install the official v0.23.1 build manually.
announcements.content:
Cockpit Tools v0.23.0 was published by mistake and has been withdrawn.

This version was built from an incorrect integration branch. It may contain PR changes that were not fully reviewed or tested, and its auto-update channel may point to the wrong release source.

If your current version is v0.23.0, we do not recommend continuing to use it. The in-app updater may fail, or it may not find the official v0.23.1 release.

Please download and install the official v0.23.1 build manually as soon as possible. After installing v0.23.1, the updater will use the official release channel again.

Users on v0.22.22 or earlier do not need this manual fix and can continue using normal updates.
